bifrost: bifrost_app::keychain (springboard/sdk/src/keychain.rs) for stored secrets; springboard/sdk/src/url.rs and springboard/sdk/src/webview.rs for network and web content; springboard/src/shell/login.rs for the desktop sign-in screen; springboard/src/shell/account.rs for the local account
summary: Only secret storage has a counterpart: an app-facing keychain (generic passwords, per app) and a local account. There is no web authentication session, no passkey or FIDO2 API, no AutoFill or credential provider, no Sign in with Apple, and no credential import or export. Most of the framework is a gap for a desktop that has no account service of its own.

gaps: Web authentication session: an API that opens a sign-in page in an isolated session and returns the callback URL to the app (ASWebAuthenticationSession), with a callback scheme that the shell routes to the requesting app.
Passkeys and FIDO2: a platform authenticator, public-key credential registration and assertion, and WebAuthn support in the browser (springboard/apps/browser/README.md lists WebAuthn as broken).
Shared credential store and AutoFill: keychain access groups (shared items between apps), a save-password prompt, and a credential provider for the browser and other apps.
One-time passcodes: capture and suggestion of verification codes delivered to the device.
Credential import and export in the CXF format.
Keychain access control: biometric or user-presence protection of items (already listed as a parity gap in docs/bifrost-ui.md, Keychain section).
